rows.text: Intended for use in healthy adults and as part of a healthy, balanced diet and exercise program.

Add 1 rounded teaspoon of Micronized Creatine Powder to a protein shake or a glass of your favorite flavored beverage. Then mix it up with a spoon. Tip: Power-up protein, meal replacement, and weight-gainer shakes with a rounded teaspoon of Micronized Creatine Powder.

WARNING: Consuming this product can expose you to chemicals including lead, which are known to the State of California to cause cancer. For more information go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov/food. Statements regarding dietary supplements have not been evaluated by the FDA and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or health condition.

Optimum Nutrition Micronized Creatine Powder is manufactured with the same creatine monohydrate found in our other premium creatine products. This creatine for women and men is formulated to support explosive movements. These creatine nutritional supplements have 5 g of creatine monohydrate in just 1 serving. Use these creatine supplements to support muscle size, strength, and power when used consistently over time in conjunction with a balanced diet and regular weight training. Optimum Nutrition is part of the Glanbia global nutrition group and has been setting the Gold Standard in sports nutrition for more than 30 years — helping performance-focused athletes achieve their goals. We are proud to say that we are one of the few sports nutrition companies who own and operate our own production facilities. We take as much pride and care in crafting our award-winning supplements as our consumers do with crafting their fitness accomplishments.

Previous page 
 
 
 
 
 Next page 
 
 
 
 
 What is Creatine?   It's naturally occurring in many of the foods we eat such as meat and fish. Taken consistently over time, Creatine supplements can help replenish the muscle’s energy stores for short bursts of high-intensity, anaerobic activity.
 How safe is Creatine to take as a supplement?   Creatine is one of the most studied, scientifically supported supplements around. It can help fuel performance, and support strength and power muscle mass, and aid recovery. Optimum Nutrition's Creatine is also Banned Substance Tested.
 Who uses Creatine?   Explosive athletes commonly use because Creatine helps support high-intensity training and performance. It's also effective for helping support muscle strength, making it a popular supplement for power-based athletes engaged in resistance training.
 When should I be taking Creatine?   Creatine supplementation is likely most beneficial when taken as a consistent, daily supplement, rather than sporadically. Taking Creatine pre-workout or post-exercise is less important than remembering to take it regularly.

items.description:
About this item  5G MICRONIZED CREATINE MONOHYDRATE PER SERVING: Each scoop delivers 5g of pure creatine monohydrate to support strength, power, and performance. Unflavored powder mixes easily into shakes or your daily routine
SUPPORTS MUSCLE STRENGTH & MUSCLE BUILDING: Creatine helps support muscle, muscle power, muscle endurance, and the building of lean muscle and even helps fuel and unlock strength to assist with progressive training programs
PERFORMANCE SUPPORT DURING TRAINING:Formulated to support performance in explosive movements, maximal effort lifts, and intense exercise sessions. Helps support training capacity and volume so you can take on more reps and sets during demanding workouts
ENERGY & RECOVERY: Creatine supports cellular energy to help you train harder and helps replenish muscle ATP/energy during strenuous exercise & even enhances recovery between repeated bouts of exercise and after strenuous training, helping you return ready for the next session
QUALITY TESTED: Optimum Nutrition Creatine Powder is banned substance tested and part of the informed choice program which is regularly tested for banned substances, so you feel comfortable and safe down to the last capsule!
Optimum Nutrition is the World's #1 Sports Nutrition Brand- Highest quality control measures so you feel comfortable and safe consuming the product
